mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 0.1%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.1%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) triggers market expectations of aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) from prior month values signal broad consumer demand contraction, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.5%), a monthly decline in unemployment rate signals labor market improvement that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5% and UNRATE declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) above its 3-month moving average indicates strengthening manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 3-month MA, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth exceeding 2.0% (GDPC1 > 2.0% YoY) signals robust economic expansion that boosts corporate earnings expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 YoY > 2.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly non-farm payrolls growth exceeding 200,000 (PAYEMS > 200,000) indicates strong labor market conditions that increase consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS > 200,000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) above its 6-month moving average indicates sustained housing market strength that drives consumer confidence and retail activity, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 6-month MA, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
